title: Elemis’ Sean Harrington joins investment bank Lempriere Wells to chart new beauty chapter
summary: Sean Harrington, who co-founded luxury British spa and skin care brand Elemis, is writing the next chapter of his beauty story at global investment bank Lempriere Wells. Cosmetics Business hears his ambitions and his reflections on 37 years with Elemis

extraction.key_fact: 럭셔리 영국 스파 및 스킨케어 브랜드의 공동 설립자가 글로벌 투자 은행에 합류했다.
